name: @abianbiya/llm-audit
description: See what pi actually sends and where it comes from: per-source attribution of the system prompt (AGENTS.md, skills, memory), per-tool schema cost, real token usage — one /llm-audit command with a settings panel and a clickable HTML report (pi extension).
